Those seed evaluations are completely independent of each other,\n// which gives three nested levels of parallelism that are exploited here:\n//\n//   * MPI    - the seed set of a round is distributed over the ranks of the\n//              cluster; the winning (seed, cardinality) pair is combined with\n//              a single MAXLOC all-reduce per round.\n//   * OpenMP - each rank drives all of the GPUs assigned to it with one host\n//              thread per device, and performs the (much cheaper) host-side\n//              phases (winner re-grow, membership bookkeeping, validation)\n// c += blockDim.x) {\n            if (clustered[c] || c == seed) continue;\n            if (devDist(mat, pts, N, seed, c) < threshold) cnt++;\n        }\n        scount[tid] = cnt;\n        __syncthreads();\n        for (int off = blockDim.x >> 1; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n            if (tid < off) scount[tid] += scount[tid + off];\n            __syncthreads();\n        }\n        if (tid == 0) bounds[s] = scount[0] + 1;\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n}\n\n// Block-wide argmin over (value, index) with lowest-index tie breaking.\n// Returns the winning slot position through *posOut.\n__device__ __forceinline__ void blockArgMin(double* sval, int* sidx, int* spos,\n                                            double& bval, int& bidx, int& bpos) {\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    sval[tid] = bval;\n    sidx[tid] = bidx;\n    spos[tid] = bpos;\n    __syncthreads();\n    for (int off = blockDim.x >> 1; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n        if (tid < off) {\n            const int o = tid + off;\n            if (sidx[o] >= 0 && (sidx[tid] < 0 || sval[o] < sval[tid] ||\n                                 (sval[o] == sval[tid] && sidx[o] < sidx[tid]))) {\n                sval[tid] = sval[o];\n                sidx[tid] = sidx[o];\n                spos[tid] = spos[o];\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n    bval = sval[0];\n    bidx = sidx[0];\n    bpos = spos[0];\n    __syncthreads();\n}\n\n// Grow one candidate cluster per thread block and report its cardinality.\n__global__ void growClusters(const double* __restrict__ mat,\n                             const double2* __restrict__ pts, int N,\n                             double threshold,\n                             const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                             const int* __restrict__ seeds, int nseeds,\n                             int* __restrict__ listIdx, double* __restrict__ listVal,\n                             int* __restrict__ cardOut) {\n    extern __shared__ char smem[];\n    double* sval = reinterpret_cast<double*>(smem);\n    int* sidx = reinterpret_cast<int*>(sval + blockDim.x);\n    int* spos = sidx + blockDim.x;\n    __shared__ int sCount;\n\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const size_t base = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * N;\n    int* myIdx = listIdx + base;\n    double* myVal = listVal + base;\n\n    for (int s = blockIdx.x; s < nseeds; s += gridDim.x) {\n        const int seed = seeds[s];\n\n        // Phase A: build the candidate list = unclustered points within the\n        // threshold of the seed, together with their distance to the seed\n        // (which is their running max-distance to the one-element cluster).\n        if (tid == 0) sCount = 0;\n        __syncthreads();\n        for (int c = tid; c < N; c += blockDim.x) {\n            if (clustered[c] || c == seed) continue;\n            const double d = devDist(mat, pts, N, seed, c);\n            if (d < threshold) {\n                const int p = atomicAdd(&sCount, 1);\n                myIdx[p] = c;\n                myVal[p] = d;\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n        const int m = sCount;\n\n        // Phase B: greedily add the candidate with the smallest running max\n        // distance until nothing fits below the threshold any more.\n        int card = 1;\n        int chosen = -1;   // last added member; -1 => list values are current\n        while (true) {\n            double bval = CUDART_INF;\n            int bidx = -1, bpos = -1;\n            for (int j = tid; j < m; j += blockDim.x) {\n                double v = myVal[j];\n                if (v == CUDART_INF) continue;\n                const int c = myIdx[j];\n                if (chosen >= 0) {\n                    const double d = devDist(mat, pts, N, chosen, c);\n                    if (d > v) v = d;\n                    if (!(v < threshold)) v = CUDART_INF;\n                    myVal[j] = v;\n                    if (v == CUDART_INF) continue;\n                }\n                if (bidx < 0 || v < bval || (v == bval && c < bidx)) {\n                    bval = v;\n                    bidx = c;\n                    bpos = j;\n                }\n            }\n            __syncthreads();\n            blockArgMin(sval, sidx, spos, bval, bidx, bpos);\n            if (bidx < 0) break;\n            if (tid == 0) myVal[bpos] = CUDART_INF;\n            chosen = bidx;\n            card++;\n            __syncthreads();\n        }\n\n        if (tid == 0) cardOut[s] = card;\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Host side: per-GPU context\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstruct GpuContext {\n    int device = 0;\n    int blocks = 0;\n    int threads = 0;\n    double* d_mat = nullptr;      // may be null -> distances computed on the fly\n    double2* d_pts = nullptr;\n    unsigned char* d_clustered = nullptr;\n    int* d_seeds = nullptr;\n    int* d_card = nullptr;\n    int* d_bounds = nullptr;\n    int* d_listIdx = nullptr;\n    double* d_listVal = nullptr;\n    cudaStream_t stream = nullptr;\n    std::vector<int> h_seeds;\n    std::vector<int> h_out;\n};\n\nstatic int roundPow2AtMost(int v, int lo, int hi) {\n    int p = lo;\n    while (p * 2 <= v && p * 2 <= hi) p *= 2;\n    return p;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Host re-grow of the winning cluster (OpenMP parallel).\n// Mirrors the device kernel exactly, so it yields identical members.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nstatic void growClusterHost(int seed, const std::vector<unsigned char>& clustered,\n                            const std::vector<Point>& points, double threshold,\n                            int N, std::vector<int>& members,\n                            std::vector<int>& idxBuf, std::vector<double>& valBuf) {\n    members.clear();\n    members.push_back(seed);\n\n    idxBuf.clear();\n    valBuf.clear();\n    for (int c = 0; c < N; ++c) {\n        if (clustered[c] || c == seed) continue;\n        const double d = distance(points[seed], points[c]);\n        if (d < threshold) {\n            idxBuf.push_back(c);\n            valBuf.push_back(d);\n        }\n    }\n\n    const int m = static_cast<int>(idxBuf.size());\n    const int* idx = idxBuf.data();\n    double* val = valBuf.data();\n    const double INF = std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();\n    int chosen = -1;\n\n    while (true) {\n        double bestVal = INF;\n        int bestIdx = -1, bestPos = -1;\n\n        const bool par = m >= 4096;\n        #pragma omp parallel if(par)\n        {\n            double lval = INF;\n            int lidx = -1, lpos = -1;\n            #pragma omp for schedule(static) nowait\n            for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {\n                double v = val[j];\n                if (v == INF) continue;\n                const int c = idx[j];\n                if (chosen >= 0) {\n                    const double d = distance(points[chosen], points[c]);\n                    if (d > v) v = d;\n                    if (!(v < threshold)) v = INF;\n                    val[j] = v;\n                    if (v == INF) continue;\n                }\n                if (lidx < 0 || v < lval || (v == lval && c < lidx)) {\n                    lval = v; lidx = c; lpos = j;\n                }\n            }\n            #pragma omp critical\n            {\n                if (lidx >= 0 && (bestIdx < 0 || lval < bestVal ||\n                                  (lval == bestVal && lidx < bestIdx))) {\n                    bestVal = lval; bestIdx = lidx; bestPos = lpos;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (bestIdx < 0) break;\n        val[bestPos] = INF;\n        chosen = bestIdx;\n        members.push_back(bestIdx);\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Main QT clustering algorithm (hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA)\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    if (N <= 0) return clusters;\n\n    // --- device discovery / assignment ------------------------------------\n    int deviceCount = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));\n    if (deviceCount <= 0) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"No CUDA device available\\n\");\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n\n    MPI_Comm shmComm;\n    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, g_rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &shmComm);\n    int localRank = 0, localSize = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(shmComm, &localRank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(shmComm, &localSize);\n    MPI_Comm_free(&shmComm);\n\n    // Ranks share the node's GPUs; if there are at least as many GPUs as ranks\n    // on the node, a rank drives several of them with one OpenMP thread each.\n    std::vector<int> myDevices;\n    if (localSize <= deviceCount) {\n        const int first = localRank * deviceCount / localSize;\n        const int last = (localRank + 1) * deviceCount / localSize;\n        for (int d = first; d < last; ++d) myDevices.push_back(d);\n    } else {\n        myDevices.push_back(localRank % deviceCount);\n    }\n    const int nGpu = static_cast<int>(myDevices.size());\n\n    // --- per-GPU setup -----------------------------------------------------\n    std::vector<GpuContext> ctx(nGpu);\n    std::vector<double2> hpts(N);\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) hpts[i] = make_double2(points[i].x, points[i].y);\n\n    const int threadsPerBlock = roundPow2AtMost(N / 4, 32, 256);\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for num_threads(nGpu) schedule(static, 1)\n    for (int g = 0; g < nGpu; ++g) {\n        GpuContext& c = ctx[g];\n        c.device = myDevices[g];\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(c.device));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreate(&c.stream));\n        c.threads = threadsPerBlock;\n\n        cudaDeviceProp prop;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&prop, c.device));\n\n        size_t freeMem = 0, totalMem = 0;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&freeMem, &totalMem));\n\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.d_pts, sizeof(double2) * N));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(c.d_pts, hpts.data(), sizeof(double2) * N, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.d_clustered, N));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.d_seeds, sizeof(int) * N));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.d_card, sizeof(int) * N));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.d_bounds, sizeof(int) * N));\n\n        // Precompute the full distance matrix when it comfortably fits; it\n        // turns the growth kernel into a purely memory bound loop.\n        const size_t matBytes = sizeof(double) * static_cast<size_t>(N) * N;\n        const size_t budget = static_cast<size_t>(0.45 * static_cast<double>(freeMem));\n        if (matBytes <= budget && cudaMalloc(&c.d_mat, matBytes) == cudaSuccess) {\n            dim3 blk(256);\n            dim3 grd((N + 255) / 256, N);\n            buildDistanceMatrix<<<grd, blk>>>(c.d_mat, c.d_pts, N);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n        } else {\n            c.d_mat = nullptr;\n        }\n\n        // As many resident blocks as the device can hold, bounded by the\n        // scratch memory each block needs (one candidate list of size N).\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&freeMem, &totalMem));\n        const size_t perBlock = static_cast<size_t>(N) * (sizeof(int) + sizeof(double));\n        size_t maxBlocks = static_cast<size_t>(0.6 * static_cast<double>(freeMem)) / perBlock;\n        int blocks = prop.multiProcessorCount * 8;\n        if (blocks > N) blocks = N;\n        if (static_cast<size_t>(blocks) > maxBlocks) blocks = static_cast<int>(maxBlocks);\n        if (blocks < 1) blocks = 1;\n        c.blocks = blocks;\n\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.d_listIdx, sizeof(int) * static_cast<size_t>(blocks) * N));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.d_listVal, sizeof(double) * static_cast<size_t>(blocks) * N));\n        c.h_seeds.reserve(N);\n        c.h_out.resize(N);\n    }\n\n    // Total number of candidate clusters that can be grown concurrently by the\n    // whole job - used as the size of the pruning wave.\n    int localWidth = 0;\n    for (int g = 0; g < nGpu; ++g) localWidth += ctx[g].blocks;\n    int globalWidth = 0;\n    MPI_Allreduce(&localWidth, &globalWidth, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_SUM, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    if (globalWidth < 1) globalWidth = 1;\n\n    // --- host state (replicated on every rank) -----------------------------\n    std::vector<unsigned char> clustered(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered;\n    unclustered.reserve(N);\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) unclustered.push_back(i);\n\n    std::vector<int> allSeeds, allBounds, order, waveSeeds, mySeeds;\n    std::vector<int> memberBuf, idxBuf;\n    std::vector<double> valBuf;\n    idxBuf.reserve(N);\n    valBuf.reserve(N);\n\n    std::vector<int> countsBuf(g_size), displsBuf(g_size);\n\n    // Runs one wave of seeds through the local GPUs and returns the best\n    // (cardinality, seed) found locally.\n    auto runWave = [&](const std::vector<int>& seeds, int& bestCard, int& bestSeed) {\n        bestCard = -1;\n        bestSeed = -1;\n        const int n = static_cast<int>(seeds.size());\n        if (n == 0) return;\n        // Round-robin over the GPUs; the wave is ordered by decreasing work so\n        // this balances the load well.\n        for (int g = 0; g < nGpu; ++g) ctx[g].h_seeds.clear();\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) ctx[i % nGpu].h_seeds.push_back(seeds[i]);\n\n        std::vector<int> gCard(nGpu, -1), gSeed(nGpu, -1);\n        #pragma omp parallel for num_threads(nGpu) schedule(static, 1)\n        for (int g = 0; g < nGpu; ++g) {\n            GpuContext& c = ctx[g];\n            const int ns = static_cast<int>(c.h_seeds.size());\n            if (ns == 0) continue;\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(c.device));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(c.d_seeds, c.h_seeds.data(), sizeof(int) * ns,\n                                       cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, c.stream));\n            const int grid = std::min(ns, c.blocks);\n            const size_t shmem = c.threads * (sizeof(double) + 2 * sizeof(int));\n            growClusters<<<grid, c.threads, shmem, c.stream>>>(\n                c.d_mat, c.d_pts, N, threshold, c.d_clustered, c.d_seeds, ns,\n                c.d_listIdx, c.d_listVal, c.d_card);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(c.h_out.data(), c.d_card, sizeof(int) * ns,\n                                       cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, c.stream));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(c.stream));\n            int bc = -1, bs = -1;\n            for (int i = 0; i < ns; ++i) {\n                const int card = c.h_out[i];\n                const int sd = c.h_seeds[i];\n                if (card > bc || (card == bc && sd < bs)) { bc = card; bs = sd; }\n            }\n            gCard[g] = bc;\n            gSeed[g] = bs;\n        }\n        for (int g = 0; g < nGpu; ++g) {\n            if (gSeed[g] < 0) continue;\n            if (gCard[g] > bestCard || (gCard[g] == bestCard && gSeed[g] < bestSeed)) {\n                bestCard = gCard[g];\n                bestSeed = gSeed[g];\n            }\n        }\n    };\n\n    // --- main clustering loop ---------------------------------------------\n    while (!unclustered.empty()) {\n        const int S = static_cast<int>(unclustered.size());\n\n        // Upload the current clustered mask.\n        #pragma omp parallel for num_threads(nGpu) schedule(static, 1)\n        for (int g = 0; g < nGpu; ++g) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(ctx[g].device));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(ctx[g].d_clustered, clustered.data(), N,\n                                  cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n        }\n\n        // Split the seeds of this round over the ranks (block distribution).\n        const int beg = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(S) * g_rank / g_size);\n        const int end = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(S) * (g_rank + 1) / g_size);\n        mySeeds.assign(unclustered.begin() + beg, unclustered.begin() + end);\n\n        // Cardinality upper bounds for the local seeds, gathered globally so\n        // every rank can select and prune identically.\n        std::vector<int> myBounds(mySeeds.size(), 0);\n        if (!mySeeds.empty()) {\n            GpuContext& c = ctx[0];\n            const int ns = static_cast<int>(mySeeds.size());\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(c.device));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(c.d_seeds, mySeeds.data(), sizeof(int) * ns,\n                                  cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n            const int grid = std::min(ns, c.blocks);\n            computeBounds<<<grid, c.threads, c.threads * sizeof(int)>>>(\n                c.d_mat, c.d_pts, N, threshold, c.d_clustered, c.d_seeds, ns, c.d_bounds);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(myBounds.data(), c.d_bounds, sizeof(int) * ns,\n                                  cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n        }\n\n        allBounds.resize(S);\n        for (int r = 0; r < g_size; ++r) {\n            const int b = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(S) * r / g_size);\n            const int e = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(S) * (r + 1) / g_size);\n            countsBuf[r] = e - b;\n            displsBuf[r] = b;\n        }\n        MPI_Allgatherv(myBounds.data(), static_cast<int>(myBounds.size()), MPI_INT,\n                       allBounds.data(), countsBuf.data(), displsBuf.data(), MPI_INT,\n                       MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        // Order the seeds by decreasing upper bound (index ascending on ties).\n        order.resize(S);\n        for (int i = 0; i < S; ++i) order[i] = i;\n        std::sort(order.begin(), order.end(), [&](int a, int b) {\n            if (allBounds[a] != allBounds[b]) return allBounds[a] > allBounds[b];\n            return unclustered[a] < unclustered[b];\n        });\n\n        // Wave 1: the most promising seeds, enough to fill the whole machine.\n        const int wave1 = std::min(S, globalWidth);\n        allSeeds.resize(S);\n        for (int i = 0; i < S; ++i) allSeeds[i] = unclustered[order[i]];\n\n        int globalCard = -1, globalSeed = -1;\n        for (int pass = 0; pass < 2; ++pass) {\n            waveSeeds.clear();\n            if (pass == 0) {\n                for (int i = 0; i < wave1; ++i) waveSeeds.push_back(allSeeds[i]);\n            } else {\n                // Wave 2: only seeds that can still beat - or tie and win\n                // against - the current best are worth evaluating.\n                for (int i = wave1; i < S; ++i) {\n                    const int ub = allBounds[order[i]];\n                    const int sd = allSeeds[i];\n                    if (ub > globalCard || (ub == globalCard && sd < globalSeed)) {\n                        waveSeeds.push_back(sd);\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            const int nw = static_cast<int>(waveSeeds.size());\n            if (nw == 0) continue;\n\n            // Strided split over the ranks keeps the (sorted) work balanced.\n            mySeeds.clear();\n            for (int i = g_rank; i < nw; i += g_size) mySeeds.push_back(waveSeeds[i]);\n\n            int bc = -1, bs = -1;\n            runWave(mySeeds, bc, bs);\n\n            int in[2] = {bc, bs < 0 ? std::numeric_limits<int>::max() : bs};\n            int out[2];\n            MPI_Allreduce(in, out, 1, MPI_2INT, MPI_MAXLOC, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n            // MAXLOC keeps the smallest \"location\" among equal values, which is\n            // exactly the lowest-seed-index tie break of the original code.\n            if (out[0] > globalCard || (out[0] == globalCard && out[1] < globalSeed)) {\n                globalCard = out[0];\n                globalSeed = out[1];\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (globalSeed < 0 || globalCard <= 0) break;\n\n        // Re-grow the winner on the host (cheap, and identical bit for bit).\n        growClusterHost(globalSeed, clustered, points, threshold, N, memberBuf,\n                        idxBuf, valBuf);\n\n        Cluster cluster;\n        cluster.seed_point = globalSeed;\n        cluster.members = memberBuf;\n        clusters.push_back(std::move(cluster));\n\n        for (int mIdx : memberBuf) clustered[mIdx] = 1;\n        unclustered.erase(std::remove_if(unclustered.begin(), unclustered.end(),\n                                         [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx] != 0; }),\n                          unclustered.end());\n    }\n\n    // --- cleanup -----------------------------------------------------------\n    for (int g = 0; g < nGpu; ++g) {\n        GpuContext& c = ctx[g];\n        cudaSetDevice(c.device);\n        cudaFree(c.d_mat);\n        cudaFree(c.d_pts);\n        cudaFree(c.d_clustered);\n        cudaFree(c.d_seeds);\n        cudaFree(c.d_card);\n        cudaFree(c.d_bounds);\n        cudaFree(c.d_listIdx);\n        cudaFree(c.d_listVal);\n        cudaStreamDestroy(c.stream);\n    }\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n\n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n\n    const int nc = static_cast<int>(clusters.size());\n    std::vector<double> diameters(nc, 0.0);\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 1)\n    for (int c = 0; c < nc; ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]],\n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n        diameters[c] = max_diameter;\n    }\n\n    for (int c = 0; c < nc; ++c) {\n        const double max_diameter = diameters[c];\n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %d: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\",\n                   c, clusters[c].members.size(), clusters[c].seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n\n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %d has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\",\n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %zu)\\n\",\n                       member, membership[member], c);\n                valid = false;\n            }\n            membership[member] = static_cast<int>(c);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Count clustered points\n    int clustered_count = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < membership.size(); ++i) {\n        if (membership[i] >= 0) clustered_count++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Total points: %zu, Clustered: %d, Unclustered: %zu\\n\",\n           points.size(), clustered_count, points.size() - clustered_count);\n\n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of points (default: 1000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <float>   Distance threshold for clustering (default: 2.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int provided = 0;\n    MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided);\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &g_rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &g_size);\n\n    int num_points = 1000;\n    double threshold = 2.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n over the ranks of the\n//              cluster; the winning (seed, cardinality) pair is combined with\n//              a single MAXLOC all-reduce per round.\n//   * OpenMP - each rank drives all of matrix.\n__global__ void buildDistanceMatrix(double* __restrict__ mat,\n                                    const double2* __restrict__ pts, int N) {\n    const int j = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    const int i = blockIdx.y;\n    if (j >= N) return;\n    const double2 pa = pts[i];\n    const double2 pb = pts[j];\n    mat[static_cast<size_t>(i) * N + j] = devDistance(pa.x, pa.y, pb.x, pb.y);\n}\n\n// Number of still unclustered points strictly within the threshold of each\n// candidate seed (including the seed itself).  This is an upper bound on the\n// cardinality of the cluster the seed can grow, because every cluster member\n// must be within the threshold of every other member.\n__global__ void computeBounds(const double* __restrict__ mat,\n                              const double2* __restrict__ pts, int N,\n                              double threshold,\n                              const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                              const int* __restrict__ seeds, int nseeds,\n                              int* __restrict__ bounds) {\n    extern __shared__ int scount[];\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    for (int s = blockIdx.x; s < nseeds; s += gridDim.x) {\n        const int seed = seeds[s];\n        int cnt = 0;\n        for (int c = tid; c < N; c += blockDim.x) {\n            if (clustered[c] || c == seed) continue;\n            if (devDist(mat, pts, N, seed, c) < threshold) cnt++;\n        }\n        scount[tid] = cnt;\n        __syncthreads();\n        for (int off = blockDim.x >> 1; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n            if (tid < off) scount[tid] += scount[tid + off];\n            __syncthreads();\n        }\n        if (tid == 0) bounds[s] = scount[0] + 1;\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n}\n\n// Block-wide argmin over (value, index) with lowest-index tie breaking.\n// Returns the winning slot position through *posOut.\n__device__ __forceinline__ void blockArgMin(double* sval, int* sidx, int* spos,\n                                            double& bval, int& bidx, int& bpos) {\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    sval[tid] = bval;\n    sidx[tid] = bidx;\n    spos[tid] = bpos;\n    __syncthreads();\n    for (int off = blockDim.x >> 1; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n        if (tid < off) {\n            const int o = tid + off;\n            if (sidx[o] >= 0 && (sidx[tid] < 0 || sval[o] < sval[tid] ||\n                                 (sval[o] == sval[tid] && sidx[o] < sidx[tid]))) {\n                sval[tid] = sval[o];\n                sidx[tid] = sidx[o];\n                spos[tid] = spos[o];\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n    bval = sval[0];\n    bidx = sidx[0];\n    bpos = spos[0];\n    __syncthreads();\n}\n\n// Grow one candidate cluster per thread block and report its cardinality.\n__global__ void growClusters(const double* __restrict__ mat,\n                             const double2* __restrict__ pts, int N,\n                             double threshold,\n                             const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                             const int* __restrict__ seeds, int nseeds,\n                             int* __restrict__ listIdx, double* __restrict__ listVal,\n                             int* __restrict__ cardOut) {\n    extern __shared__ char smem[];\n    double* sval = reinterpret_cast<double*>(smem);\n    int* sidx = reinterpret_cast<int*>(sval + blockDim.x);\n    int* spos = sidx + blockDim.x;\n    __shared__ int sCount;\n\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const size_t base = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * N;\n    int* myIdx = listIdx + base;\n    double* myVal = listVal + base;\n\n    for (int s = blockIdx.x; s < nseeds; s += gridDim.x) {\n        const int seed = seeds[s];\n\n        // Phase A: build the candidate list = unclustered points within the\n        // threshold of the seed, together with their distance to the seed\n        // (which is their running max-distance to the one-element cluster).\n        if (tid == 0) sCount = 0;\n        __syncthreads();\n        for (int c = tid; c < N; c += blockDim.x) {\n            if (clustered[c] || c == seed) continue;\n            const double d = devDist(mat, pts, N, seed, c);\n            if (d < threshold) {\n                const int p = atomicAdd(&sCount, 1);\n                myIdx[p] = c;\n                myVal[p] = d;\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n        const int m = sCount;\n\n        // Phase B: greedily add the candidate with the smallest running max\n        // distance until nothing fits below the threshold any more.\n        int card = 1;\n        int chosen = -1;   // last added member; -1 => list values are current\n        while (true) {\n            double bval = CUDART_INF;\n            int bidx = -1, bpos = -1;\n            for (int j = tid; j < m; j += blockDim.x) {\n                double v = myVal[j];\n                if (v == CUDART_INF) continue;\n                const int c = myIdx[j];\n                if (chosen >= 0) {\n                    const double d = devDist(mat, pts, N, chosen, c);\n                    if (d > v) v = d;\n                    if (!(v < threshold)) v = CUDART_INF;\n                    myVal[j] = v;\n                    if (v == CUDART_INF) continue;\n                }\n                if (bidx < 0 || v < bval || (v == bval && c < bidx)) {\n                    bval = v;\n                    bidx = c;\n                    bpos = j;\n                }\n            }\n            __syncthreads();\n            blockArgMin(sval, sidx, spos, bval, bidx, bpos);\n            if (bidx < 0) break;\n            if (tid == 0) myVal[bpos] = CUDART_INF;\n            chosen = bidx;\n            card++;\n            __syncthreads();\n        }\n\n        if (tid == 0) cardOut[s] = card;\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Host side: per-GPU context\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstruct GpuContext {\n    int device = 0;\n    int blocks = 0;\n    int threads = 0;\n    double* d_mat = nullptr;      // may be null -> distances computed on the fly\n    double2* d_pts = nullptr;\n    unsigned char* d_clustered = nullptr;\n    int* d_seeds = nullptr;\n    int* d_card = nullptr;\n    int* d_bounds = nullptr;\n    int* d_listIdx = nullptr;\n    double* d_listVal = nullptr;\n    cudaStream_t stream = nullptr;\n    std::vector<int> h_seeds;\n    std::vector<int> h_out;\n};\n\nstatic int roundPow2AtMost(int v, int lo, int hi) {\n    int p = lo;\n    while (p * 2 <= v && p * 2 <= hi) p *= 2;\n    return p;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Host re-grow of the winning cluster (OpenMP parallel).\n// Mirrors the device kernel exactly, so it yields identical members.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nstatic void growClusterHost(int seed, const std::vector<unsigned char>& clustered,\n                            const std::vector<Point>& points, double threshold,\n                            int N, std::vector<int>& members,\n                            std::vector<int>& idxBuf, std::vector<double>& valBuf) {\n    members.clear();\n    members.push_back(seed);\n\n    idxBuf.clear();\n    valBuf.clear();\n    for (int c = 0; c < N; ++c) {\n        if (clustered[c] || c == seed) continue;\n        const double d = distance(points[seed], points[c]);\n        if (d < threshold) {\n            idxBuf.push_back(c);\n            valBuf.push_back(d);\n        }\n    }\n\n    const int m = static_cast<int>(idxBuf.size());\n    const int* idx = idxBuf.data();\n    double* val = valBuf.data();\n    const double INF = std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();\n    int chosen = -1;\n\n    while (true) {\n        double bestVal = INF;\n        int bestIdx = -1, bestPos = -1;\n\n        const bool par = m >= 4096;\n        #pragma omp parallel if(par)\n        {\n            double lval = INF;\n            int lidx = -1, lpos = -1;\n            #pragma omp for schedule(static) nowait\n            for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {\n                double v = val[j];\n                if (v == INF) continue;\n                const int c = idx[j];\n                if (chosen >= 0) {\n                    const double d = distance(points[chosen], points[c]);\n                    if (d > v) v = d;\n                    if (!(v < threshold)) v = INF;\n                    val[j] = v;\n                    if (v == INF) continue;\n                }\n                if (lidx < 0 || v < lval || (v == lval && c < lidx)) {\n                    lval = v; lidx = c; lpos = j;\n                }\n            }\n            #pragma omp critical\n            {\n                if (lidx >= 0 && (bestIdx < 0 || lval < bestVal ||\n                                  (lval == bestVal && lidx < bestIdx))) {\n                    bestVal = lval; bestIdx = lidx; bestPos = lpos;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (bestIdx < 0) break;\n        val[bestPos] = INF;\n        chosen = bestIdx;\n        members.push_back(bestIdx);\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Main QT clustering algorithm (hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA)\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    if (N <= 0) return clusters;\n\n    // --- device discovery / assignment ------------------------------------\n    int deviceCount = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));\n    if (deviceCount <= 0) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"No CUDA device available\\n\");\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n\n    MPI_Comm shmComm;\n    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, g_rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &shmComm);\n    int localRank = 0, localSize = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(shmComm, &localRank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(shmComm, &localSize);\n    MPI_Comm_free(&shmComm);\n\n    // Ranks share the node's GPUs; if there are at least as many GPUs as ranks\n    // on the node, a rank drives several of them with one OpenMP thread each.\n    std::vector<int> myDevices;\n    if (localSize <= deviceCount) {\n        const int first = localRank * deviceCount / localSize;\n        const int last = (localRank + 1) * deviceCount / localSize;\n        for (int d = first; d < last; ++d) myDevices.push_back(d);\n    } else {\n        myDevices.push_back(localRank % deviceCount);\n    }\n    const int nGpu = static_cast<int>(myDevices.size());\n\n    // --- per-GPU setup -----------------------------------------------------\n    std::vector<GpuContext> ctx(nGpu);\n    std::vector<double2> hpts(N);\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) hpts[i] = make_double2(points[i].x, points[i].y);\n\n    const int threadsPerBlock = roundPow2AtMost(N / 4, 32, 256);\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for num_threads(nGpu) schedule(static, 1)\n    for (int g = 0; g < nGpu; ++g) {\n        GpuContext& c = ctx[g];\n        c.device = myDevices[g];\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(c.device));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreate(&c.stream));\n        c.threads = threadsPerBlock;\n\n        cudaDeviceProp prop;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&prop, c.device));\n\n        size_t freeMem = 0, totalMem = 0;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&freeMem, &totalMem));\n\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.d_pts, sizeof(double2) * N));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(c.d_pts, hpts.data(), sizeof(double2) * N, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.d_clustered, N));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.d_seeds, sizeof(int) * N));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.d_card, sizeof(int) * N));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.d_bounds, sizeof(int) * N));\n\n        // Precompute the full distance matrix when it comfortably fits; it\n        // turns the growth kernel into a purely memory bound loop.\n        const size_t matBytes = sizeof(double) * static_cast<size_t>(N) * N;\n        const size_t budget = static_cast<size_t>(0.45 * static_cast<double>(freeMem));\n        if (matBytes <= budget && cudaMalloc(&c.d_mat, matBytes) == cudaSuccess) {\n            dim3 blk(256);\n            dim3 grd((N + 255) / 256, N);\n            buildDistanceMatrix<<<grd, blk>>>(c.d_mat, c.d_pts, N);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n        } else {\n            c.d_mat = nullptr;\n        }\n\n        // As many resident blocks as the device can hold, bounded by the\n        // scratch memory each block needs (one candidate list of size N).\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&freeMem, &totalMem));\n        const size_t perBlock = static_cast<size_t>(N) * (sizeof(int) + sizeof(double));\n        size_t maxBlocks = static_cast<size_t>(0.6 * static_cast<double>(freeMem)) / perBlock;\n        int blocks = prop.multiProcessorCount * 8;\n        if (blocks > N) blocks = N;\n        if (static_cast<size_t>(blocks) > maxBlocks) blocks = static_cast<int>(maxBlocks);\n        if (blocks < 1) blocks = 1;\n        c.blocks = blocks;\n\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.d_listIdx, sizeof(int) * static_cast<size_t>(blocks) * N));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.d_listVal, sizeof(double) * static_cast<size_t>(blocks) * N));\n        c.h_seeds.reserve(N);\n        c.h_out.resize(N);\n    }\n\n    // Total number of candidate clusters that can be grown concurrently by the\n    // whole job - used as the size of the pruning wave.\n    int localWidth = 0;\n    for (int g = 0; g < nGpu; ++g) localWidth += ctx[g].blocks;\n    int globalWidth = 0;\n    MPI_Allreduce(&localWidth, &globalWidth, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_SUM, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    if (globalWidth < 1) globalWidth = 1;\n\n    // --- host state (replicated on every rank) -----------------------------\n    std::vector<unsigned char> clustered(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered;\n    unclustered.reserve(N);\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) unclustered.push_back(i);\n\n    std::vector<int> allSeeds, allBounds, order, waveSeeds, mySeeds;\n    std::vector<int> memberBuf, idxBuf;\n    std::vector<double> valBuf;\n    idxBuf.reserve(N);\n    valBuf.reserve(N);\n\n    std::vector<int> countsBuf(g_size), displsBuf(g_size);\n\n    // Runs one wave of seeds through the local GPUs and returns the best\n    // (cardinality, seed) found locally.\n    auto runWave = [&](const std::vector<int>& seeds, int& bestCard, int& bestSeed) {\n        bestCard = -1;\n        bestSeed = -1;\n        const int n = static_cast<int>(seeds.size());\n        if (n == 0) return;\n        // Round-robin over the GPUs; the wave is ordered by decreasing work so\n        // this balances the load well.\n        for (int g = 0; g < nGpu; ++g) ctx[g].h_seeds.clear();\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) ctx[i % nGpu].h_seeds.push_back(seeds[i]);\n\n        std::vector<int> gCard(nGpu, -1), gSeed(nGpu, -1);\n        #pragma omp parallel for num_threads(nGpu) schedule(static, 1)\n        for (int g = 0; g < nGpu; ++g) {\n            GpuContext& c = ctx[g];\n            const int ns = static_cast<int>(c.h_seeds.size());\n            if (ns == 0) continue;\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(c.device));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(c.d_seeds, c.h_seeds.data(), sizeof(int) * ns,\n                                       cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, c.stream));\n            const int grid = std::min(ns, c.blocks);\n            const size_t shmem = c.threads * (sizeof(double) + 2 * sizeof(int));\n            growClusters<<<grid, c.threads, shmem, c.stream>>>(\n                c.d_mat, c.d_pts, N, threshold, c.d_clustered, c.d_seeds, ns,\n                c.d_listIdx, c.d_listVal, c.d_card);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(c.h_out.data(), c.d_card, sizeof(int) * ns,\n                                       cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, c.stream));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(c.stream));\n            int bc = -1, bs = -1;\n            for (int i = 0; i < ns; ++i) {\n                const int card = c.h_out[i];\n                const int sd = c.h_seeds[i];\n                if (card > bc || (card == bc && sd < bs)) { bc = card; bs = sd; }\n            }\n            gCard[g] = bc;\n            gSeed[g] = bs;\n        }\n        for (int g = 0; g < nGpu; ++g) {\n            if (gSeed[g] < 0) continue;\n            if (gCard[g] > bestCard || (gCard[g] == bestCard && gSeed[g] < bestSeed)) {\n                bestCard = gCard[g];\n                bestSeed = gSeed[g];\n            }\n        }\n    };\n\n    // --- main clustering loop ---------------------------------------------\n    while (!unclustered.empty()) {\n        const int S = static_cast<int>(unclustered.size());\n\n        // Upload the current clustered mask.\n        #pragma omp parallel for num_threads(nGpu) schedule(static, 1)\n        for (int g = 0; g < nGpu; ++g) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(ctx[g].device));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(ctx[g].d_clustered, clustered.data(), N,\n                                  cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n        }\n\n        // Split the seeds of this round over the ranks (block distribution).\n        const int beg = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(S) * g_rank / g_size);\n        const int end = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(S) * (g_rank + 1) / g_size);\n        mySeeds.assign(unclustered.begin() + beg, unclustered.begin() + end);\n\n        // Cardinality upper bounds for the local seeds, gathered globally so\n        // every rank can select and prune identically.\n        std::vector<int> myBounds(mySeeds.size(), 0);\n        if (!mySeeds.empty()) {\n            GpuContext& c = ctx[0];\n            const int ns = static_cast<int>(mySeeds.size());\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(c.device));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(c.d_seeds, mySeeds.data(), sizeof(int) * ns,\n                                  cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n            const int grid = std::min(ns, c.blocks);\n            computeBounds<<<grid, c.threads, c.threads * sizeof(int)>>>(\n                c.d_mat, c.d_pts, N, threshold, c.d_clustered, c.d_seeds, ns, c.d_bounds);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(myBounds.data(), c.d_bounds, sizeof(int) * ns,\n                                  cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n        }\n\n        allBounds.resize(S);\n        for (int r = 0; r < g_size; ++r) {\n            const int b = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(S) * r / g_size);\n            const int e = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(S) * (r + 1) / g_size);\n            countsBuf[r] = e - b;\n            displsBuf[r] = b;\n        }\n        MPI_Allgatherv(myBounds.data(), static_cast<int>(myBounds.size()), MPI_INT,\n                       allBounds.data(), countsBuf.data(), displsBuf.data(), MPI_INT,\n                       MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        // Order the seeds by decreasing upper bound (index ascending on ties).\n        order.resize(S);\n        for (int i = 0; i < S; ++i) order[i] = i;\n        std::sort(order.begin(), order.end(), [&](int a, int b) {\n            if (allBounds[a] != allBounds[b]) return allBounds[a] > allBounds[b];\n            return unclustered[a] < unclustered[b];\n        });\n\n        // Wave 1: the most promising seeds, enough to fill the whole machine.\n        const int wave1 = std::min(S, globalWidth);\n        allSeeds.resize(S);\n        for (int i = 0; i < S; ++i) allSeeds[i] = unclustered[order[i]];\n\n        int globalCard = -1, globalSeed = -1;\n        for (int pass = 0; pass < 2; ++pass) {\n            waveSeeds.clear();\n            if (pass == 0) {\n                for (int i = 0; i < wave1; ++i) waveSeeds.push_back(allSeeds[i]);\n            } else {\n                // Wave 2: only seeds that can still beat - or tie and win\n                // against - the current best are worth evaluating.\n                for (int i = wave1; i < S; ++i) {\n                    const int ub = allBounds[order[i]];\n                    const int sd = allSeeds[i];\n                    if (ub > globalCard || (ub == globalCard && sd < globalSeed)) {\n                        waveSeeds.push_back(sd);\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            const int nw = static_cast<int>(waveSeeds.size());\n            if (nw == 0) continue;\n\n            // Strided split over the ranks keeps the (sorted) work balanced.\n            mySeeds.clear();\n            for (int i = g_rank; i < nw; i += g_size) mySeeds.push_back(waveSeeds[i]);\n\n            int bc = -1, bs = -1;\n            runWave(mySeeds, bc, bs);\n\n            int in[2] = {bc, bs < 0 ? std::numeric_limits<int>::max() : bs};\n            int out[2];\n            MPI_Allreduce(in, out, 1, MPI_2INT, MPI_MAXLOC, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n            // MAXLOC keeps the smallest \"location\" among equal values, which is\n            // exactly the lowest-seed-index tie break of the original code.\n            if (out[0] > globalCard || (out[0] == globalCard && out[1] < globalSeed)) {\n                globalCard = out[0];\n                globalSeed = out[1];\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (globalSeed < 0 || globalCard <= 0) break;\n\n        // Re-grow the winner on the host (cheap, and identical bit for bit).\n        growClusterHost(globalSeed, clustered, points, threshold, N, memberBuf,\n                        idxBuf, valBuf);\n\n        Cluster cluster;\n        cluster.seed_point = globalSeed;\n        cluster.members = memberBuf;\n        clusters.push_back(std::move(cluster));\n\n        for (int mIdx : memberBuf) clustered[mIdx] = 1;\n        unclustered.erase(std::remove_if(unclustered.begin(), unclustered.end(),\n                                         [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx] != 0; }),\n                          unclustered.end());\n    }\n\n    // --- cleanup -----------------------------------------------------------\n    for (int g = 0; g < nGpu; ++g) {\n        GpuContext& c = ctx[g];\n        cudaSetDevice(c.device);\n        cudaFree(c.d_mat);\n        cudaFree(c.d_pts);\n        cudaFree(c.d_clustered);\n        cudaFree(c.d_seeds);\n        cudaFree(c.d_card);\n        cudaFree(c.d_bounds);\n        cudaFree(c.d_listIdx);\n        cudaFree(c.d_listVal);\n        cudaStreamDestroy(c.stream);\n    }\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n\n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n\n    const int nc = static_cast<int>(clusters.size());\n    std::vector<double> diameters(nc, 0.0);\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 1)\n    for (int c = 0; c < nc; ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]],\n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n        diameters[c] = max_diameter;\n    }\n\n    for (int c = 0; c < nc; ++c) {\n        const double max_diameter = diameters[c];\n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %d: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\",\n                   c, clusters[c].members.size(), clusters[c].seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n\n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %d has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\",\n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %zu)\\n\",\n                       member, membership[member], c);\n                valid = false;\n            }\n            membership[member] = static_cast<int>(c);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Count clustered pa.y, pb.x, pb.y);\n}\n\n// Fill the (symmetric) distance matrix.\n__global__ void buildDistanceMatrix(double* __restrict__ mat,\n                                    const double2* __restrict__ pts, int N) {\n    const int j = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    const int i = blockIdx.y;\n    if (j >= N) return;\n    const double2 pa = pts[i];\n    const double2 pb = pts[j];\n    mat[static_cast<size_t>(i) * N + j] = devDistance(pa.x, pa.y, pb.x, pb.y);\n}\n\n// Number of still unclustered points strictly within the threshold of each\n// candidate seed (including the seed itself).  This is an upper bound on the\n// cardinality of the cluster the seed can grow, because every cluster member\n// must be within the threshold of every other member.\n__global__ void computeBounds(const double* __restrict__ mat,\n                              const double2* __restrict__ pts, int N,\n                              double threshold,\n                              const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                              const int* __restrict__ seeds, int nseeds,\n                              int* __restrict__ bounds) {\n    extern __shared__ int scount[];\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    for (int s = blockIdx.x; s < nseeds; s += gridDim.x) {\n        const int seed = seeds[s];\n        int cnt = 0;\n        for (int c = tid; c < N; c += blockDim.x) {\n            if (clustered[c] || c == seed) continue;\n            if (devDist(mat, pts, N, seed, c) < threshold) cnt++;\n        }\n        scount[tid] = cnt;\n        __syncthreads();\n        for (int off = blockDim.x >> 1; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n            if (tid < off) scount[tid] += scount[tid + off];\n            __syncthreads();\n        }\n        if (tid == 0) bounds[s] = scount[0] + 1;\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n}\n\n// Block-wide argmin over (value, index) with lowest-index tie breaking.\n// Returns the winning slot position through *posOut.\n__device__ __forceinline__ void blockArgMin(double* sval, int* sidx, int* spos,\n                                            double& bval, int& bidx, int& bpos) {\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    sval[tid] = bval;\n    sidx[tid] = bidx;\n    spos[tid] = bpos;\n    __syncthreads();\n    for (int off = blockDim.x >> 1; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n        if (tid < off) {\n            const int o = tid + off;\n            if (sidx[o] >= 0 && (sidx[tid] < 0 || sval[o] < sval[tid] ||\n                                 (sval[o] == sval[tid] && sidx[o] < sidx[tid]))) {\n                sval[tid] = sval[o];\n                sidx[tid] = sidx[o];\n                spos[tid] = spos[o];\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n    bval = sval[0];\n    bidx = sidx[0];\n    bpos = spos[0];\n    __syncthreads();\n}\n\n// Grow one candidate cluster per thread block and report its cardinality.\n__global__ void growClusters(const double* __restrict__ mat,\n                             const double2* __restrict__ pts, int N,\n                             double threshold,\n                             const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                             const int* __restrict__ seeds, int nseeds,\n                             int* __restrict__ listIdx, double* __restrict__ listVal,\n                             int* __restrict__ cardOut) {\n    extern __shared__ char smem[];\n    double* sval = reinterpret_cast<double*>(smem);\n    int* sidx = reinterpret_cast<int*>(sval + blockDim.x);\n    int* spos = sidx + blockDim.x;\n    __shared__ int sCount;\n\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const size_t base = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * N;\n    int* myIdx = listIdx + base;\n    double* myVal = listVal + base;\n\n    for (int s = blockIdx.x; s < nseeds; s += gridDim.x) {\n        const int seed = seeds[s];\n\n        // Phase A: build the candidate list = unclustered points within the\n        // threshold of the seed, together with their distance to the seed\n        // (which is their running max-distance to the one-element cluster).\n        if (tid == 0) sCount = 0;\n        __syncthreads();\n        for (int c = tid; c < N; c += blockDim.x) {\n            if (clustered[c] || c == seed) continue;\n            const double d = devDist(mat, pts, N, seed, c);\n            if (d < threshold) {\n                const int p = atomicAdd(&sCount, 1);\n                myIdx[p] = c;\n                myVal[p] = d;\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n        const int m = sCount;\n\n        // Phase B: greedily add the candidate with the smallest running max\n        // distance until nothing fits below the threshold any more.\n        int card = 1;\n        int chosen = -1;   // last added member; -1 => list values are current\n        while (true) {\n            double bval = CUDART_INF;\n            int bidx = -1, bpos = -1;\n            for (int j = tid; j < m; j += blockDim.x) {\n                double v = myVal[j];\n                if (v == CUDART_INF) continue;\n                const int c = myIdx[j];\n                if (chosen >= 0) {\n                    const double d = devDist(mat, pts, N, chosen, c);\n                    if (d > v) v = d;\n                    if (!(v < threshold)) v = CUDART_INF;\n                    myVal[j] = v;\n                    if (v == CUDART_INF) continue;\n                }\n                if (bidx < 0 || v < bval || (v == bval && c < bidx)) {\n                    bval = v;\n                    bidx = c;\n                    bpos = j;\n                }\n            }\n            __syncthreads();\n            blockArgMin(sval, sidx, spos, bval, bidx, bpos);\n            if (bidx < 0) break;\n            if (tid == 0) myVal[bpos] = CUDART_INF;\n            chosen = bidx;\n            card++;\n            __syncthreads();\n        }\n\n        if (tid == 0) cardOut[s] = card;\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Host side: per-GPU context\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstruct GpuContext {\n    int device = 0;\n    int blocks = 0;\n    int threads = 0;\n    double* d_mat = nullptr;      // may be null -> distances computed on the fly\n    double2* d_pts = nullptr;\n    unsigned char* d_clustered = nullptr;\n    int* d_seeds = nullptr;\n    int* d_card = nullptr;\n    int* d_bounds = nullptr;\n    int* d_listIdx = nullptr;\n    double* d_listVal = nullptr;\n    cudaStream_t stream = nullptr;\n    std::vector<int> h_seeds;\n    std::vector<int> h_out;\n};\n\nstatic int roundPow2AtMost(int v, int lo, int hi) {\n    int p = lo;\n    while (p * 2 <= v && p * 2 <= hi) p *= 2;\n    return p;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Host re-grow of the winning cluster (OpenMP parallel).\n// Mirrors the device kernel exactly, so it yields identical members.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nstatic void growClusterHost(int seed, const std::vector<unsigned char>& clustered,\n                            const std::vector<Point>& points, double threshold,\n                            int N, std::vector<int>& members,\n                            std::vector<int>& idxBuf, std::vector<double>& valBuf) {\n    members.clear();\n    members.push_back(seed);\n\n    idxBuf.clear();\n    valBuf.clear();\n    for (int c = 0; c < N; ++c) {\n        if (clustered[c] || c == seed) continue;\n        const double d = distance(points[seed], points[c]);\n        if (d < threshold) {\n            idxBuf.push_back(c);\n            valBuf.push_back(d);\n        }\n    }\n\n    const int m = static_cast<int>(idxBuf.size());\n    const int* idx = idxBuf.data();\n    double* val = valBuf.data();\n    const double INF = std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();\n    int chosen = -1;\n\n    while (true) {\n        double bestVal = INF;\n        int bestIdx = -1, bestPos = -1;\n\n        const bool par = m >= 4096;\n        #pragma omp parallel if(par)\n        {\n            double lval = INF;\n            int lidx = -1, lpos = -1;\n            #pragma omp for schedule(static) nowait\n            for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {\n                double v = val[j];\n                if (v == INF) continue;\n                const int c = idx[j];\n                if (chosen >= 0) {\n                    const double d = distance(points[chosen], points[c]);\n                    if (d > v) v = d;\n                    if (!(v < threshold)) v = INF;\n                    val[j] = v;\n                    if (v == INF) continue;\n                }\n                if (lidx < 0 || v < lval || (v == lval && c < lidx)) {\n                    lval = v; lidx = c; lpos = j;\n                }\n            }\n            #pragma omp critical\n            {\n                if (lidx >= 0 && (bestIdx < 0 || lval < bestVal ||\n                                  (lval == bestVal && lidx < bestIdx))) {\n                    bestVal = lval; bestIdx = lidx; bestPos = lpos;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (bestIdx < 0) break;\n        val[bestPos] = INF;\n        chosen = bestIdx;\n        members.push_back(bestIdx);\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Main QT clustering algorithm (hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA)\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    if (N <= 0) return clusters;\n\n    const std::vector<int>& myDevices = g_myDevices;\n    const int nGpu = static_cast<int>(myDevices.size());\n\n    // --- per-GPU setup -----------------------------------------------------\n    std::vector<GpuContext> ctx(nGpu);\n    std::vector<double2> hpts(N);\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) hpts[i] = make_double2(points[i].x, points[i].y);\n\n    const int threadsPerBlock = roundPow2AtMost(N / 4, 32, 256);\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for num_threads(nGpu) schedule(static, 1)\n    for (int g = 0; g < nGpu; ++g) {\n        GpuContext& c = ctx[g];\n        c.device = myDevices[g];\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(c.device));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreate(&c.stream));\n        c.threads = threadsPerBlock;\n\n        cudaDeviceProp prop;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&prop, c.device));\n\n        size_t freeMem = 0, totalMem = 0;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&freeMem, &totalMem));\n\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.d_pts, sizeof(double2) * N));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(c.d_pts, hpts.data(), sizeof(double2) * N, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.d_clustered, N));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.d_seeds, sizeof(int) * N));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.d_card, sizeof(int) * N));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.d_bounds, sizeof(int) * N));\n\n        // Precompute the full distance matrix when it comfortably fits; it\n        // turns the growth kernel into a purely memory bound loop.\n        const size_t matBytes = sizeof(double) * static_cast<size_t>(N) * N;\n        const size_t budget = static_cast<size_t>(0.45 * static_cast<double>(freeMem));\n        if (matBytes <= budget && cudaMalloc(&c.d_mat, matBytes) == cudaSuccess) {\n            dim3 blk(256);\n            dim3 grd((N + 255) / 256, N);\n            buildDistanceMatrix<<<grd, blk>>>(c.d_mat, c.d_pts, N);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n        } else {\n            c.d_mat = nullptr;\n        }\n\n        // As many resident blocks as the device can hold, bounded by the\n        // scratch memory each block needs (one candidate list of size N).\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&freeMem, &totalMem));\n        const size_t perBlock = static_cast<size_t>(N) * (sizeof(int) + sizeof(double));\n        size_t maxBlocks = static_cast<size_t>(0.6 * static_cast<double>(freeMem)) / perBlock;\n        int blocks = prop.multiProcessorCount * 8;\n        if (blocks > N) blocks = N;\n        if (static_cast<size_t>(blocks) > maxBlocks) blocks = static_cast<int>(maxBlocks);\n        if (blocks < 1) blocks = 1;\n        c.blocks = blocks;\n\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.d_listIdx, sizeof(int) * static_cast<size_t>(blocks) * N));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.d_listVal, sizeof(double) * static_cast<size_t>(blocks) * N));\n        c.h_seeds.reserve(N);\n        c.h_out.resize(N);\n    }\n\n    // Total number of candidate clusters that can be grown concurrently by the\n    // whole job - used as the size of the pruning wave.\n    int localWidth = 0;\n    for (int g = 0; g < nGpu; ++g) localWidth += ctx[g].blocks;\n    int globalWidth = 0;\n    MPI_Allreduce(&localWidth, &globalWidth, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_SUM, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    if (globalWidth < 1) globalWidth = 1;\n\n    // --- host state (replicated on every rank) -----------------------------\n    std::vector<unsigned char> clustered(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered;\n    unclustered.reserve(N);\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) unclustered.push_back(i);\n\n    std::vector<int> allSeeds, allBounds, order, waveSeeds, mySeeds;\n    std::vector<int> memberBuf, idxBuf;\n    std::vector<double> valBuf;\n    idxBuf.reserve(N);\n    valBuf.reserve(N);\n\n    std::vector<int> countsBuf(g_size), displsBuf(g_size);\n\n    // Runs one wave of seeds through the local GPUs and returns the best\n    // (cardinality, seed) found locally.\n    auto runWave = [&](const std::vector<int>& seeds, int& bestCard, int& bestSeed) {\n        bestCard = -1;\n        bestSeed = -1;\n        const int n = static_cast<int>(seeds.size());\n        if (n == 0) return;\n        // Round-robin over the GPUs; the wave is ordered by decreasing work so\n        // this balances the load well.\n        for (int g = 0; g < nGpu; ++g) ctx[g].h_seeds.clear();\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) ctx[i % nGpu].h_seeds.push_back(seeds[i]);\n\n        std::vector<int> gCard(nGpu, -1), gSeed(nGpu, -1);\n        #pragma omp parallel for num_threads(nGpu) schedule(static, 1)\n        for (int g = 0; g < nGpu; ++g) {\n            GpuContext& c = ctx[g];\n            const int ns = static_cast<int>(c.h_seeds.size());\n            if (ns == 0) continue;\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(c.device));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(c.d_seeds, c.h_seeds.data(), sizeof(int) * ns,\n                                       cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, c.stream));\n            const int grid = std::min(ns, c.blocks);\n            const size_t shmem = c.threads * (sizeof(double) + 2 * sizeof(int));\n            growClusters<<<grid, c.threads, shmem, c.stream>>>(\n                c.d_mat, c.d_pts, N, threshold, c.d_clustered, c.d_seeds, ns,\n                c.d_listIdx, c.d_listVal, c.d_card);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(c.h_out.data(), c.d_card, sizeof(int) * ns,\n                                       cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, c.stream));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(c.stream));\n            int bc = -1, bs = -1;\n            for (int i = 0; i < ns; ++i) {\n                const int card = c.h_out[i];\n                const int sd = c.h_seeds[i];\n                if (card > bc || (card == bc && sd < bs)) { bc = card; bs = sd; }\n            }\n            gCard[g] = bc;\n            gSeed[g] = bs;\n        }\n        for (int g = 0; g < nGpu; ++g) {\n            if (gSeed[g] < 0) continue;\n            if (gCard[g] > bestCard || (gCard[g] == bestCard && gSeed[g] < bestSeed)) {\n                bestCard = gCard[g];\n                bestSeed = gSeed[g];\n            }\n        }\n    };\n\n    // --- main clustering loop ---------------------------------------------\n    while (!unclustered.empty()) {\n        const int S = static_cast<int>(unclustered.size());\n\n        // Upload the current clustered mask.\n        #pragma omp parallel for num_threads(nGpu) schedule(static, 1)\n        for (int g = 0; g < nGpu; ++g) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(ctx[g].device));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(ctx[g].d_clustered, clustered.data(), N,\n                                  cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n        }\n\n        // Split the seeds of this round over the ranks (block distribution).\n        const int beg = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(S) * g_rank / g_size);\n        const int end = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(S) * (g_rank + 1) / g_size);\n        mySeeds.assign(unclustered.begin() + beg, unclustered.begin() + end);\n\n        // Cardinality upper bounds for the local seeds, gathered globally so\n        // every rank can select and prune identically.\n        std::vector<int> myBounds(mySeeds.size(), 0);\n        if (!mySeeds.empty()) {\n            GpuContext& c = ctx[0];\n            const int ns = static_cast<int>(mySeeds.size());\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(c.device));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(c.d_seeds, mySeeds.data(), sizeof(int) * ns,\n                                  cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n            const int grid = std::min(ns, c.blocks);\n            computeBounds<<<grid, c.threads, c.threads * sizeof(int)>>>(\n                c.d_mat, c.d_pts, N, threshold, c.d_clustered, c.d_seeds, ns, c.d_bounds);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(myBounds.data(), c.d_bounds, sizeof(int) * ns,\n                                  cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n        }\n\n        allBounds.resize(S);\n        for (int r = 0; r < g_size; ++r) {\n            const int b = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(S) * r / g_size);\n            const int e = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(S) * (r + 1) / g_size);\n            countsBuf[r] = e - b;\n            displsBuf[r] = b;\n        }\n        MPI_Allgatherv(myBounds.data(), static_cast<int>(myBounds.size()), MPI_INT,\n                       allBounds.data(), countsBuf.data(), displsBuf.data(), MPI_INT,\n                       MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        // Order the seeds by decreasing upper bound (index ascending on ties).\n        order.resize(S);\n        for (int i = 0; i < S; ++i) order[i] = i;\n        std::sort(order.begin(), order.end(), [&](int a, int b) {\n            if (allBounds[a] != allBounds[b]) return allBounds[a] > allBounds[b];\n            return unclustered[a] < unclustered[b];\n        });\n\n        // Wave 1: the most promising seeds, enough to fill the whole machine.\n        const int wave1 = std::min(S, globalWidth);\n        allSeeds.resize(S);\n        for (int i = 0; i < S; ++i) allSeeds[i] = unclustered[order[i]];\n\n        int globalCard = -1, globalSeed = -1;\n        for (int pass = 0; pass < 2; ++pass) {\n            waveSeeds.clear();\n            if (pass == 0) {\n                for (int i = 0; i < wave1; ++i) waveSeeds.push_back(allSeeds[i]);\n            } else {\n                // Wave 2: only seeds that can still beat - or tie and win\n                // against - the current best are worth evaluating.\n                for (int i = wave1; i < S; ++i) {\n                    const int ub = allBounds[order[i]];\n                    const int sd = allSeeds[i];\n                    if (ub > globalCard || (ub == globalCard && sd < globalSeed)) {\n                        waveSeeds.push_back(sd);\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            const int nw = static_cast<int>(waveSeeds.size());\n            if (nw == 0) continue;\n\n            // Strided split over the ranks keeps the (sorted) work balanced.\n            mySeeds.clear();\n            for (int i = g_rank; i < nw; i += g_size) mySeeds.push_back(waveSeeds[i]);\n\n            int bc = -1, bs = -1;\n            runWave(mySeeds, bc, bs);\n\n            int in[2] = {bc, bs < 0 ? std::numeric_limits<int>::max() : bs};\n            int out[2];\n            MPI_Allreduce(in, out, 1, MPI_2INT, MPI_MAXLOC, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n            // MAXLOC keeps the smallest \"location\" among equal values, which is\n            // exactly the lowest-seed-index tie break of the original code.\n            if (out[0] > globalCard || (out[0] == globalCard && out[1] < globalSeed)) {\n                globalCard = out[0];\n                globalSeed = out[1];\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (globalSeed < 0 || globalCard <= 0) break;\n\n        // Re-grow the winner on the host (cheap, and identical bit for bit).\n        growClusterHost(globalSeed, clustered, points, threshold, N, memberBuf,\n                        idxBuf, valBuf);\n\n        Cluster cluster;\n        cluster.seed_point = globalSeed;\n        cluster.members = memberBuf;\n        clusters.push_back(std::move(cluster));\n\n        for (int mIdx : memberBuf) clustered[mIdx] = 1;\n        unclustered.erase(std::remove_if(unclustered.begin(), unclustered.end(),\n                                         [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx] != 0; }),\n                          unclustered.end());\n    }\n\n    // --- cleanup -----------------------------------------------------------\n    for (int g = 0; g < nGpu; ++g) {\n        GpuContext& c = ctx[g];\n        cudaSetDevice(c.device);\n        cudaFree(c.d_mat);\n        cudaFree(c.d_pts);\n        cudaFree(c.d_clustered);\n        cudaFree(c.d_seeds);\n        cudaFree(c.d_card);\n        cudaFree(c.d_bounds);\n        cudaFree(c.d_listIdx);\n        cudaFree(c.d_listVal);\n        cudaStreamDestroy(c.stream);\n    }\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n\n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n\n    const int nc = static_cast<int>(clusters.size());\n    std::vector<double> diameters(nc, 0.0);\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 1)\n    for (int c = 0; c < nc; ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]],\n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n        diameters[c] = max_diameter;\n    }\n\n    for (int c = 0; c < nc; ++c) {\n        const double max_diameter = diameters[c];\n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %d: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\",\n                   c, clusters[c].members.size(), clusters[c].seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n\n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %d has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\",\n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %zu)\\n\",\n                       member, membership[member], c);\n                valid = false;\n            }\n            membership[member] = static_cast<int>(c);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Count clustered points\n    int clustered_count = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < membership.size(); ++i) {\n        if (membership[i] >= 0) clustered_count++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Total points: %zu, Clustered: %d, Unclustered: %zu\\n\",\n           points.size(), clustered_count, points.size() - clustered_count);\n\n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of points (default: 1000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <float>   Distance threshold for clustering (default: 2.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int Those seed evaluations are completely independent of each other,\n// which gives three nested levels of parallelism that are exploited here:\n//\n//   * MPI    - the seed set of a round is distributed over the ranks of the\n//              cluster; Doing\n// this up front keeps the one-off CUDA driver initialisation out of the\n// measured clustering phase.\nstatic void initDevices() {\n    int deviceCount = 0;\n    if (cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount) != cudaSuccess || deviceCount <= 0) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"No CUDA device available\\n\");\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n\n    MPI_Comm MPI_Comm_size(shmComm, &localSize);\n    MPI_Comm_free(&shmComm);\n\n    // Ranks share the node's GPUs; if there are at least as many GPUs as ranks\n    // on the node, a rank drives several of them with one OpenMP thread each.\n    g_myDevices.clear();\n    if (localSize <= deviceCount) {\n        const int first = localRank * deviceCount / localSize;\n        const int last = (localRank + 1) * static_cast<int>(g_myDevices.size());\n    #pragma omp parallel for num_threads(nGpu) schedule(static, 1)\n    for (int g = 0; g < nGpu; ++g) {\n        cudaSetDevice(g_myDevices[g]);\n        cudaFree(nullptr);   // force context creation\n    }\n}\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n
